2610.13755.title: Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training
2610.13755.paper_summary: Training long-horizon language model agents requires assigning credit to intermediate decisions from sparse terminal feedback. Within a finite group of sibling rollouts, useful action comparisons depend on their context, evidence for both alternatives, and how that evidence enters learning. We propose Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization (MCGPO), a procedure for constructing weighted action preferences from already collected trajectories. MCGPO defines comparison contexts with pre-action state summaries and observed rubric progress, annotated by task rules. Two-action support selects among ordered exact and coarse matching rules. Fixed folds separate candidate decisions from the terminal outcomes used to orient their preferences, and support-dependent evidence weights scale an auxiliary pairwise objective alongside shared GraphGPO task learning. MCGPO reuses rollout data and each response's original history, preserving critic-free training. Across six environment-backbone settings with three training seeds each, MCGPO improves mean success over matched GraphGPO: by 0.47-1.46 percentage points on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B and 7B, and by 3.96 and 5.16 points on WebShop with Qwen3-4B and 8B. The ALFWorld gains build on baseline success above 92%, where remaining headroom is limited. Integrated success improves in three of four Qwen2.5 settings. Three-seed factorial controls support opposite-fold evidence and evidence weighting; joint state-rubric matching achieves the highest mean in all four representation-control settings.
2610.13755.paper_summary_zh: 訓練長期語言模型代理需要從稀疏的終端反饋中為中間決策分配信用。在有限的兄弟回合組中，有用的行動比較依賴於其上下文、兩種選擇的證據，以及這些證據如何進入學習。我們提出了匹配上下文群體策略優化（MCGPO），這是一種從已收集的軌跡中構建加權行動偏好的程序。MCGPO通過預行動狀態摘要和觀察到的標準進展來定義比較上下文，並由任務規則進行註釋。兩行動支持在有序的精確和粗略匹配規則之間進行選擇。固定折疊將候選決策與用於定向其偏好的終端結果分開，並且支持依賴的證據權重在共享GraphGPO任務學習的同時擴展輔助成對目標。MCGPO重用回合數據和每個回應的原始歷史，保持無評論的訓練。在六個環境-骨幹設置中，每個設置有三個訓練種子，MCGPO在匹配的GraphGPO上提高了平均成功率：在ALFWorld和WebShop上提高了0.47-1.46個百分點，使用Qwen2.5-1.5B和7B，並在WebShop上提高了3.96和5.16個百分點，使用Qwen3-4B和8B。ALFWorld的增益建立在92%以上的基線成功之上，剩餘的提升空間有限。在四個Qwen2.5設置中，整體成功在三個設置中有所改善。三種種子因子控制支持相反折疊的證據和證據權重；聯合狀態-標準匹配在所有四個表示控制設置中實現了最高的平均值。
